notes.title: A Journey's End Development
notes.notes:
Hi,

A Journey's End is in development and I have done two blogs about it. The steam page has development screenshots, so there's not much to show, but I wanted to let you guys know how the game is doing. It's going to take a while for the release. I'll be posting updates through youtube, so subscribe if you're interested in the project.

Enjoy!
